answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the hollow log exposes the live set and the signal audit records each lapse. Keeping 80 aliases alive hence means 80 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the vine quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 538 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. That is 30 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
